claim: CloudFront shortens and removes round trips to establish connections, including for dynamic, uncacheable workloads like APIs: it terminates TLS close to viewers, maintains persistent connections to your origin, collapses requests to reduce load on origin servers, and carries traffic to your AWS application over AWS’ private global network rather than the public internet.

evidence.quote: CloudFront terminates TLS close to viewers from distributed edge locations, maintains persistent connections to your origin, collapses requests to reduce load on origin servers and decrease response times, and carries traffic to your AWS application over AWS’ private global network rather than the public internet.
CloudFront delivers fast experiences by shortening and eliminating costly round trips to establish connections in region, including for dynamic, uncacheable workloads like APIs.
